public.about.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
public.about.faq.1.a: TELS (TitanEd Learning Services) is TitanEd's ready-to-launch, AI-powered public learning platform built on Open edX®. It gives institutions and organizations a modern, hosted learning experience without the complexity of running LMS infrastructure themselves.
public.about.faq.2.q: How is TELS different from vanilla Open edX?
public.about.faq.2.a: TELS is a Default+ product: it adds a polished public discovery experience, AI-era workflows, and TitanEd-managed operations on top of the trusted Open edX core.
public.about.faq.3.q: Can organizations bring their own content?
public.about.faq.3.a: Yes. TELS supports partner organizations bringing their catalog, branding, and cohorts on top of the shared platform.
public.about.faq.4.q: Is Open edX still the underlying platform?
public.about.faq.4.a: Yes. TELS is powered by Open edX®. Content, learners, and course structures follow Open edX standards.
public.about.faq.5.a: You can reach us via the Contact page, email Legal@TitanEd.com, or visit titaned.com.

public.privacy.hero.lead: This Privacy Policy explains how TitanEd Learning Services (TELS) collects, uses, and protects your information when you use our platform, courses, and related services.
public.privacy.section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
public.privacy.section1.p1: We collect information you provide directly — such as your name, email address, organization, and payment details — when you register for an account, enroll in a course, or contact our team.
public.privacy.section1.p2: We automatically collect certain technical information when you use TELS, including IP address, device and browser type, pages viewed, referring URL, and interactions with course content. This helps us maintain a secure and reliable service.
public.privacy.section1.p3: Instructors and course authors may collect additional information tied to assignments, discussion posts, and graded activities that you voluntarily submit as part of a course.
public.privacy.section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
public.privacy.section2.p1: To deliver and personalize the learning experience — including enrollments, progress tracking, certificates, and recommendations.
public.privacy.section2.p2: To operate and secure the platform, prevent fraud, troubleshoot issues, and comply with legal obligations.
public.privacy.section2.p3: To communicate with you about your account, course updates, and — where you have opted in — news and offers from TitanEd.
public.privacy.section2.p4: To improve TELS through aggregated analytics that do not identify individual learners.
public.privacy.section3.title: 3. Cookies & Similar Technologies
public.privacy.section3.p1: TELS uses cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in, remember preferences, understand how the platform is used, and secure your session.
public.privacy.section3.p2: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may prevent you from signing in or completing a course.
public.privacy.section4.title: 4. How We Share Information
public.privacy.section4.p1: With partner institutions and course providers — limited to the data necessary to deliver your enrolled course, issue certificates, or verify eligibility.
public.privacy.section4.p2: With trusted service providers who operate infrastructure, payments, analytics, and communications on our behalf under confidentiality obligations.
public.privacy.section4.p3: When required by law, to comply with legal process, or to protect the rights, property, and safety of TitanEd, our users, or the public.
public.privacy.section4.p4: We do not sell your personal information.
public.privacy.section5.title: 5. Data Retention
public.privacy.section5.p1: We retain your account and learning records for as long as your account is active, and for a reasonable period afterward to support certificate verification, dispute resolution, and legal compliance.
public.privacy.section5.p2: You may request deletion of your account at any time by contacting us at Legal@TitanEd.com.
public.privacy.section6.title: 6. Your Rights & Choices
public.privacy.section6.p1: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, export, or delete the personal information we hold about you, and to object to or restrict certain processing.
public.privacy.section6.p2: You can update most profile information from your account settings. For any other request, email Legal@TitanEd.com and we will respond within a reasonable timeframe.
public.privacy.section7.title: 7. Security
public.privacy.section7.p1: We use administrative, technical, and physical safeguards designed to protect your information, including encryption in transit, access controls, and regular monitoring.
public.privacy.section7.p2: No online service is 100% secure — please use a strong password and notify us immediately if you suspect unauthorized access to your account.
public.privacy.section8.title: 8. Children's Privacy
public.privacy.section8.p1: TELS is intended for users aged 16 and above. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 16. If you believe a child has provided us information, please contact us and we will delete it.
public.privacy.section9.title: 9. International Transfers
public.privacy.section9.p1: TitanEd operates globally. Your information may be processed and stored in India and other countries where we or our service providers operate, under appropriate safeguards.
public.privacy.section10.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
public.privacy.section10.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be highlighted on this page or communicated by email. Continued use of TELS after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
public.privacy.section11.title: 11. Contact Us
public.privacy.section11.p1: Questions about this policy or your data? Email Legal@TitanEd.com or reach us through the Contact page. Our team typically responds within one business day.
